players.product: Laser process equipment (TGV glass-core drilling, glass cutting with ABF grooving, glass-carrier laser debonding, laser marking) and microwave/RF plasma equipment (cleaning, descum, de-smear, dry etch, deep silicon etching) for glass-core substrates and fan-out panel-level packaging (700 x 700 mm)

quarterly_data.signal: E&R's July 2026 operations deck ('Finance status 2026~', revenue in KNTD) shows Q1 2026 revenue of NT$382,000 thousand and monthly revenue of NT$157,000 thousand in April, NT$223,000 thousand in May and NT$247,000 thousand in June 2026. The deck positions its laser and plasma tools for AI packaging: 2.5D CoWoS / EMIB-T and 3D InFO / Foveros, glass interposer TGV, ABF laser via and plasma descum, and 600/700 mm fan-out panel-level packaging lines.
